description: Defines an abstract class JobResult representing the outcome of a job execution, including counts of successful, failed, and discarded tasks, timestamps, and processing logic for task results.

classes.name: JobResult
classes.description: Abstract class representing the result of a job execution, including counts, timestamps, and task results.

methods.name: getCompletedCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of completed tasks (successful + failed + discarded).

methods.name: processTaskResult
methods.description: Processes a TaskResult, updating counts and storing error results if applicable.

methods.name: getJobType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the type of job, to be implemented by subclasses.
